title: Rust basic Stack delivers broadcast-link frames with foreign IPv6 unicast destinations
description: Security review P2. The newly added wire_is_for_local_stack in rust/lichen-node/src/stack.rs returns true unconditionally for AddrMode::None. receive() then authenticates/decompresses and returns ReceivedIpv6 without checking the reconstructed IPv6 destination. Consequently a signed L2 broadcast containing IPv6 unicast for another node is delivered to every Stack/application and can trigger handle_and_reply, creating destination confusion and unintended processing. After decompression, require destination to equal a configured local address or valid multicast for all L2 modes; add a multi-node test proving foreign IPv6 unicast over broadcast is ignored.
